trans-unit.source: So what is a unicorn, anyway?
trans-unit.target: So what is a unicorn, anyway?

trans-unit.source: <Mint> said it's the embodiment of clerical artes.
trans-unit.target: <Mint> said it's the embodiment of clerical artes.

trans-unit.source: No, I mean... What does it look like?
trans-unit.target: No, I mean... What does it look like?

trans-unit.source: It's just a horned horse, yeah?
trans-unit.target: It's just a horned horse, yeah?

trans-unit.source: It is not a horse! The unicorn is a unicorn!
trans-unit.target: It is not a horse! The unicorn is a unicorn!

trans-unit.source: Yeah, yeah, I hear you. Now, shall we go meet it?
trans-unit.target: Yeah, yeah, I hear you. Now, shall we go meet it?
